reference.operation: Affix ConfigProvider.affix className/style on the outer wrapper with local style priority, inherited undefined, whole-record replacement and empty record clearing. Local prefixCls changes only fixed inner classes and generated selectors; CSS variable names remain independent of the local component prefix. Includes default/empty/custom/overlapping/shared-marker prefixes, named cssVar/component overrides, own default sibling, unfixed/fixed typography, geometry and flow placeholder. Per-control scroll hosts normalize viewport coordinates; source geometry and UMD are not patched. Hash and native CSS-variable markers are excluded from prefix identity.
